title: GrowFolio
tagline: Easily deposit funds and use them in any defi strategy through a simple multi click flow.
description: StableFolio is built using SwiftUI for an intuitive iOS frontend that abstracts DeFi complexity into familiar banking-style interfaces, while the backend leverages Solidity smart contracts implementing the ERC-4626 tokenized vault standard to create auto-compounding PYUSD strategies.
